tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 9. Work entirely inside your current working directory; never modify anything outside CWD; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - both defects measured live on v104 (the currently-flipped version) during Ankit's phone test: DEFECT A, keyword extraction instead of sentence comprehension: the patient message 'I'm leaving town today and won't be back for 2 weeks about then?' extracted the date phrase 'today' (from 'leaving town today') and offered SAME-DAY slots. The extractors, copied verbatim from production n_ask, grab date phrases without interpreting availability semantics. The patient's correction 'No I said two weeks' then extracted 'two weeks' and worked (the gateway now parses relative offsets correctly - that layer is fixed and live). DEFECT B, latency: measured agent reply gaps are v96 ~4.5s vs goal-loop v103/v104 ~7.6-8.3s. Cause analysis: n_goal_response carries a 5,617-character prompt, 9 outbound edges, and 6 extractors, so every turn runs extraction + routing + generation over a much larger context than any single v96 node. SOURCE MATERIALS (read-only; copy into CWD before editing): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD8/gl-round8-fix/ has the round-8 draft (minted v104), validator (assertions 1-8), build scripts, fixtures; /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD4/capture-v96/graph.json is the stored production graph (n_ask holds the original extractor texts). THE FIX, exactly: (1) EXTRACTION COMPREHENSION: extend the description text of the preference_from and preference_to extractors (only those two; user_verbatim, day_part, time_after stay byte-identical to v96) with an availability-interpretation rule stating, in the same style as the existing description: interpret the WHOLE sentence; when the patient mentions leaving, being away, out of town, unavailable, or won't be back until some period, extract the date or period they CAN come in (their return/availability), never a date they state as unavailable; include this canonical example pair in the description: the message 'I'm leaving town today and won't be back for 2 weeks - how about then?' extracts 'in 2 weeks', not 'today'. Apply the identical updated pair on EVERY user-wait feeder that carries these extractors (n_goal_response, n_date_conflict, n_date_conflict_retry, n_gate_1, n_gate_2). Ship the complete five-extractor set as ./frozen-extractors.json (a JSON array in the same [name, type, description] shape) - this is the new pin the validator and external check enforce. (2) PROMPT COMPRESSION: rewrite the n_goal_response prompt to at most 3,600 characters (from 5,617) while preserving every behavior contract verbatim where it matters: the offer copy must still template {{slot_1_day_name}} {{slot_1_start}} / {{slot_2_day_name}} {{slot_2_start}} literally; the miss/empty/unbookable/clarify branches keep their meaning and their one-clarify-then-search discipline; the opening path text stays; the bans (no promise/waiting copy, no invented clock times, clock times only from slot variables at offer steps) stay explicit. Cut redundancy, repeated background, and verbose phrasing - not rules. Do not touch edge labels or any other node's prompt this round. (3) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 9 to check_goalloop_graph.py keeping 1-8 intact: (a) the five shared extractors on every user-wait feeder are byte-equal to ./frozen-extractors.json (resolve the file relative to the validator's own directory so the pin travels with the artifact set); (b) the preference_from/preference_to descriptions contain the availability-interpretation rule (check for the leaving/away/won't-be-back phrasing and the extract-the-return-date instruction); (c) the n_goal_response prompt length is <= 3,600 characters. Structured FAIL lines citing 'assertion 9', no tracebacks; PASS on success. Your validator must PASS your new draft and FAIL the untouched round-8 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD8/gl-round8-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing an assertion. (4) Update build_goalloop.py for deterministic regeneration incl. frozen-extractors.json; update fixture-conformant.json for all nine assertions. (5) DEBUG.md: document both measured defects (quote the live sentence and the latency numbers: v96 ~4.5s, goal-loop ~8s), what changed (must discuss the extraction rule, the prompt compression, and the compressed character count), and the regeneration command. DELIVERABLES in CWD: build_goalloop.py, derive_goalloop.py if used, check_goalloop_graph.py, pathway-goalloop-draft.json, frozen-extractors.json, fixtures, DEBUG.md.
tasks.verified: The round-9 draft passes its nine-assertion validator and the validator rejects v104; the availability-interpretation rule is pinned into the frozen extractor set on every user-wait feeder, the n_goal_response prompt is inside the 3,600-character budget with all behavioral bans intact, and every round-8 structural floor still holds.
